abstract: A 56-year-old man presented with acute abdomen. Clinically, he was diagnosed as having perigastric abscess. On exploration, a retroperitoneal cystic teratoma was encountered. Postoperatively, he recovered uneventfully and has no residual disease two years later.
abstract_ja: 56歳の男性が急性腹症で来院した。臨床的には胃周囲膿瘍と診断された。開腹術で後腹膜嚢胞性奇形腫が認められた。術後は経過良好で、2年後も残存病変はない。
